# National Review

> National Review offers free online games including solitaire variants, word games, and puzzle games powered by Arkadium.

National Review's games section provides casual gaming entertainment with classic card games like Spider Solitaire and FreeCell, word-based challenges, and strategic puzzle games. All games are browser-based and free to play.

## Key Topics

- Free Online Games
- Solitaire Variants
- Spider Solitaire
- FreeCell Solitaire
- Card Games
- Word Games
- Puzzle Games
- Arkadium
- Scrabble-style Games
- Strategy Games
- Browser Games
- Vocabulary Builders
- Skill-based Games

## Card & Solitaire Games

- [Spider Solitaire Game](https://games.nationalreview.com/games/spider-solitaire-game): Free online Spider Solitaire card game with multiple decks and strategic gameplay
- [FreeCell Solitaire](https://games.nationalreview.com/games/freecell-solitaire): Skill-based FreeCell Solitaire game where every game is solvable

## Word & Vocabulary Games

- [Outspell](https://games.nationalreview.com/games/outspell): Free online word game with Scrabble-style gameplay and vocabulary challenges
